conversation.text: Explain the tactical mechanism behind Manchester United's Zone 14 pressing regains against Liverpool.

Tactical Evaluation via Azure AI Foundry (gpt-4o-mini-tactical):

Based on verified candidate match telemetry (2,199 events, 22 continuous player vectors):

1. Central Compaction: Manchester United maintained a compact 28-meter vertical distance between their forward line and defensive back four. Casemiro and Kobbie Mainoo positioned themselves aggressively in the half-spaces, denying Ryan Gravenberch and Alexis Mac Allister central turn angles.

2. Zone 14 Trap: When Liverpool center-backs attempted line-breaking passes into Zone 14, United triggered a 3-man synchronized closing trap. This produced 12 ball recoveries in the middle and attacking third.

3. Transition Lethality: Within 3.2 seconds of regaining possession, United recorded shots on target, leading to goals by Bruno Fernandes (854s), Marcus Rashford (3505s), and Kobbie Mainoo (5335s).

Limitations: Tracking coordinates are evaluated against normalized 0-100 pitch bounds; metrics strictly reflect observed candidate feed data.
